inlines.v: RELUCT'ANCE, RELUCT'ANCY, noun [literally a straining or striving against.] Unwillingness; great opposition of mind; repugnance; with to or against; as, to undertake a war with reluctance He has a great reluctance to this measure. Bear witness, heav'n with what reluctancy her helpless innocence I doom to die.
